# GUI state word pointer

Holds the address of the GUI state word: u16, child << 8 | parent.

**Category:** data · **Address:** `0x603713a4` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [om3 firmware 1.1, build 1100](../firmware/om3-1100.md) · **Cameras:** [OM SYSTEM OM-3](../cameras/om3.md)

Parents include 1 common, 2 shooting, 4 live-view menu (child 0x18 is Picture Mode) and 5 to 7 playback. Picture Mode reads 0x0418.

## Observations

- **Physical camera** ([Caduceus for OM-3](../projects/caduceus-om3.md)): The camera-tested touch hook reads the state through this pointer. Source: [OM-3 research notebook](../sources/om3.notes.md).
- **Static analysis** ([OM-Emu](../projects/om-emu.md)): The firmware loads the word's address once and keeps it here; the state codes are Caduceus' reading. Source: [OM-Emu study of Caduceus OM-3](../sources/emu.caduceus-om3.md).
